finding: The C094 4.35 assembly did not include Gamma and collar residuals as arithmetic inputs. The named residuals therefore fail Gate 14 ASSEMBLY and the uniform coefficient fails until a full-domain residual certificate is supplied.
condition_for_4p35: For every 0<r<=0.025, the complete near/exterior/typing coefficient plus [Gamma(r)+Collar(r)]/r^3 must be <=4.35.
unblock_artifact: A hashed full-domain certificate for Gamma(r)/r^3 and Collar(r)/r^3, or a new conservatively assembled coefficient containing explicit residual budgets.
